item.title: Version 3.3.0
item.description:
• Your licence key is now kept in the macOS Keychain instead of the app's plain preferences, and it's marked private when you copy it — so it no longer lingers in a clipboard-history app
  • Downloaded call-to-prayer recordings are checked for integrity before they're saved. A corrupted or interrupted download now falls back to a bundled adhan instead of caching a broken file
  • Security and reliability improvements to how Pro is verified and kept in sync
